## Resources for R

- [dplyr and tidyr cheat sheet](https://www.rstudio.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/data-wrangling-cheatsheet.pdf)
- [ggplot cheat sheet](https://www.rstudio.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/ggplot2-cheatsheet.pdf)
- [data table cheat sheet](https://s3.amazonaws.com/assets.datacamp.com/blog_assets/datatable_Cheat_Sheet_R.pdf)
- [RMarkdown cheat sheet](https://www.rstudio.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/rmarkdown-cheatsheet.pdf)
- [Hadley Wickham's R Style Guide](http://adv-r.had.co.nz/Style.html)
- [Tidy Eval in 5 Minutes](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nERXS3ssntw) (video)
- [Tidy Evaluation](https://tidyeval.tidyverse.org/index.html) (e-book)

- [Standard Evaluation for *_join](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/28125816/r-standard-evaluation-for-join-dplyr) (stackoverflow)
